riskAddressed: Postured factories previously prevented construction-time guard disables, but returned stores could still be called with per-put writeBudgetGuard:false or weaker minFree/maxUsage options and bypass the posture-derived guard after admission.

changes.substance: Added allowWriteBudgetGuardOverride gate, proposed-guard strength comparison, BRT_OPFS_WRITE_BUDGET_OVERRIDE_REJECTED, pre-mutation recovery detail, and snapshot visibility.
Postured OPFS factory creates stores with allowWriteBudgetGuardOverride:false so admitted stores reject disabled/weaker per-put guard overrides.
Classifies per-put guard override rejection as posture-guard-policy/write-budget-override with mutationAttempted:false.
Proves raw postured stores and postured Web-Lock guarded stores reject per-put guard disable attempts before mutation and leave fake OPFS empty.
Compacted comment-only ballast from src/opfs-block-store.mjs and src/storage-lane-scheduler.mjs, preserving code/tests while keeping source budget below the ratchet.

nonClaims: No quota reservation, eviction survival, fsync durability, Storage Buckets support, Web Lock fairness, or cross-browser proof.
Same-or-stronger per-put guard reiteration remains allowed for existing storage-lane/product paths; disabled/weaker per-put overrides are rejected on postured stores.
